uncertain: Exact outlines and door positions of the chapel side rooms, including Fairbanks’ hidden chamber, are unverified; dashed outlines indicate this.
notes: Fairbanks is optional; numbering follows a route visiting him before the final encounter.
Activate the torch in the northeastern side room to open Fairbanks’ hidden chamber.
Whitemane starts in the rear chamber and joins after Mograine first falls; her marker indicates her initial location.
Q1 and Q2 refer to bosses 2 and 3, not separate objects.
The two courtyard water sections belong to one fountain system with a waterfall between elevations; no walkable link is implied by the panel split.
Hearts of Zeal has distributed enemy drops, not a fixed quest location.
